transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Well, I guess what really brought me in is that my mind just won't stay on one thing anymore. I'm a jeweler, so I need to focus, but lately... I don't know, at the bench, I'll jump from reading a customer email to staring at a saw mark on a piece, and then I'll hear a noise outside and go check that. And by the time I sit back down, I realize I've completely lost the whole work order. It's just getting really hard to get anything done.
Do you find yourself fidgeting or feeling restless when you're sitting still?

Well, it's not so much that I'm fidgeting... it's more like I just have to be doing something. A lot of things, actually. Recently, I just started lining up all these new commissions and messaging old customers out of nowhere. I even started building a plan for a new website and sketching out this whole new Appalachian-inspired collection all at the same time. It just felt like I had to get everything moving right then and there, you know? Like I couldn't just sit and work on one piece, I had to be pushing all these big projects forward at once.
Have you been making impulsive decisions, like spending large amounts of money or acting on ideas without thinking them through?

No, I wouldn't say I've been doing anything like that. I mean, I'm busy with all these projects, but I haven't been blowing money or making crazy choices. I'm just taking on a lot of work at once. I haven't bought anything I didn't need or done anything impulsive like that.
Do you often find yourself talking a lot more than others in social situations?

No, not really. I mean... I talk to my customers about their pieces, but I don't think I'm talking any more than usual. I haven't noticed myself taking over conversations or anything like that. Just the normal amount, I guess.
Are you finding that your difficulties with focus and taking on multiple projects at once are causing problems in your relationships or daily life?

Yeah, it actually has been. I, uh... I missed a major custom delivery recently. My shop records just got so disorganized with everything going on that I actually had to stop taking new work for now. 

And my family has been checking on me a lot more lately, too. I guess they got worried about how far I’d slipped from my usual routines. So, yeah, it's definitely been causing some problems.
When did you first notice these difficulties with focus and taking on multiple projects at once?

Well, it was right after I won an award at this big jewelry show. That's when things really sped up. I felt just... wired, I guess, and kind of out of control with all the projects. That whole stretch lasted for about two weeks.
Have these difficulties with focus and taking on multiple projects continued since the two-week period after the award?

No, not really. After those two weeks, things kind of... settled down. I'm not feeling that wired anymore, and I'm not starting a bunch of new projects all at once like I was. I'm still trying to clean up the mess from it, but the actual feeling of being out of control and jumping from thing to thing... that stopped.
How long have you been experiencing difficulties with focus and organization in your daily life, including the period before and after the two-week stretch you mentioned?

Well, the focus issues with all those projects were just during that two-week stretch. But... honestly, since then, I've just been feeling really down. This heavy, depressed, guilty feeling has been hanging over me for about a month now. It makes it hard to get organized or care about getting things back on track.
Do you find that you're not enjoying things you used to like, such as your work as a jeweler?

Yeah, I guess so. I just... I haven't really touched my tools in weeks. Usually, I love being at the bench, working with the stones, but lately, I just don't have any interest in it. It's like I can't even find the motivation to sit down and try. I don't really care about doing much of anything right now, to be honest.
How often have you been feeling this heavy, depressed, guilty feeling over the past month?

It's been pretty much every day, especially these past couple weeks. I just... I wake up with this heavy, hollow feeling. It's like the shine has just gone out of everything. It gets so bad sometimes that I've actually sat in my truck and cried before going in to open the shop.
Are there any activities that you still find pleasure in or look forward to?

Honestly... no, not really. I can't think of a single thing. Usually I'd look forward to hanging out with some buddies or just messing around with my truck on the weekend, but right now... I just don't care. Nothing really sounds enjoyable to me.
Have you had any thoughts of death or suicide over the past month?

Yeah... I have. I keep having these thoughts that, you know, my family and my clients... they'd just be better off if I wasn't around anymore. I don't have a plan to do anything or whatever, but... it honestly scares me how often the thought just pops into my head lately.
How long have you been feeling this heavy, depressed, guilty feeling?
I'd say it's been hanging over me for about a month now. Yeah, right around a month of just feeling this way.
Were you having trouble enjoying things or finding pleasure in activities before that two-week stretch when you felt wired and started a lot of new projects?

No, not really. Before that whole... wired stretch, I was doing fine. I still liked going into the shop and working on my pieces, and I'd still hang out with my buddies. This whole thing where I just don't care about anything... that really just started after all that energy crashed.
Would you say this feeling of depression is the worst you've ever experienced?
I don't really know if it's the absolute worst... but it's definitely bad. I mean, it's hard to compare, you know? But this past month has just been really, really rough.
Have you ever felt this depressed before this past month?
No, I don't think so. I mean, I've had down days like anyone else, but nothing like this. This is the first time it's been this heavy and just... stuck around for this long.
Have you experienced significant weight loss or gain since you started feeling depressed?
No, not really. I haven't noticed any big changes with my weight. I mean, I haven't been weighing myself or anything, but my clothes still fit the same, so I guess it's been pretty steady.
Would you say this feeling of depression is the worst you've ever experienced in your life?

I think you asked me that a little bit ago. But, um... yeah, like I said, since I haven't ever felt this heavy before this past month, I guess it probably is the worst I've experienced. I just don't really have anything else to compare it to.
How many days in the past month have you been feeling this heavy, depressed, guilty feeling?
Pretty much every day. That heavy, guilty feeling... it's just been hanging over me for about a month now.
